result.title: Jensen Huang’s Keynote Highlights at NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026
result.description:
Europe is building its AI economy. NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang explains how AI factories are evolving to run agents and why physical AI is the next frontier.

Catch the highlights from his NVIDIA GTC Berlin keynote, including announcements across AI infrastructure, safe agents, open models, enterprise AI, healthcare, mobility, robotics, and personal AI.

result.title: NVIDIA Halos SAFE: Autonomous Vehicle Safety Evaluation From Road Testing to Simulation
result.description:
See how NVIDIA Halos SAFE AV connects real-world testing, simulation, and vehicle hardware to evaluate autonomous vehicle safety in one continuous loop.

Discover how NVIDIA Omniverse NuRec reconstructs real driving scenarios and NVIDIA Cosmos generates variations across traffic, weather, and edge cases.

result.title: Accelerating Robot Development With AI Agents and NVIDIA Isaac
result.description:
From prompts and data to real-world robot skills, frontier AI agents build training worlds, replay real-world motion, and tune physics using NVIDIA open libraries and models.

Skills are trained with NVIDIA Isaac Lab and Newton and evaluated with NVIDIA Isaac Lab-Arena, locally on NVIDIA DGX Station. Agile ONE brings those skills into the physical world, built on NVIDIA Isaac GR00T and powered by NVIDIA Jetson Thor.

📖 Read the Press Release: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-advances-isaac-platform-for-general-purpose-robotics-with-new-reference-humanoid-frameworks-simulation-pipelines-and-data
